sources.title: OpenStreetMap waterways: Meghadri Gedda, Gosthani and Yeleru Left Main Canal (Overpass extract, bbox 17.20,82.00,18.40,83.60)

provenance.note: Lengths are the OSM line inside the box, not official river lengths. The Yeleru Left Main Canal is a supply canal, not a river: it carries Yeleru reservoir water, and Godavari water lifted into the Yeleru, to the city.
